title: 第十六章初识锦衣卫二第十七章锦衣卫办案一
content_zh:
沈星河指尖在茶盏边缘轻轻摩挲，目光落在窗外熙攘的街道上，语气带着几分凝重：“我们查到，那匹御马失窃当晚，有人在城郊的乱葬岗见过类似的白色身影，但等我们赶过去时，只找到几根马鬃和一摊干涸的血迹。更奇怪的是，附近还发现了突厥人的狼牙符——这东西通常是细作之间传递消息的信物。”
萧琰端着茶盏的手微微一顿，眉头皱起：“这么说，御马很可能被突厥细作劫走了？可他们为什么要冒险偷一匹马？直接派人盗取图纸不是更方便？”
“这正是我们疑惑的地方。”沈星河从怀中掏出一张折叠整齐的纸，摊开在桌上，“这是御马失窃前的画像，你看它的马蹄——”萧琰凑近一看，只见画像上的白马右后蹄处有一道月牙形的疤痕，“这匹马三年前在狩猎时受过伤，马蹄骨里嵌了一小块铁屑，跑起来会发出特殊的‘嗒嗒’声。我们推测，突厥人或许是想利用这匹马的辨识度，把图纸带出城去，毕竟城门处对行人搜查严格，对马匹的检查反而宽松些。”
萧琰指尖在图纸边缘轻轻划过，忽然注意到画像角落有一处细微的墨痕，像是某种记号。“沈公子，你看这里——”他指着那处墨痕，“这看起来不像是画师不小心留下的，倒像是刻意画上去的。”
沈星河凑近一看，眼中闪过一丝惊讶：“你不说我还真没注意到。这记号……像是城西‘墨宝斋’的印章样式。”他立刻起身，“走，我们去墨宝斋问问。”
两人快步下楼，刚走出洛阳楼，就见街角处有几个穿着黑色短打的人鬼鬼祟祟地盯着他们。沈星河眼神一冷，不动声色地将手按在腰间的绣春刀上：“看来有人不想我们查下去。”他对萧琰低声道，“等会儿若有动静，你就往旁边的绸缎庄躲，别出来。”
萧琰刚点头，那几个黑衣人就猛地冲了过来，手中握着短刀，直扑沈星河。沈星河反应极快，拔出绣春刀，刀光一闪，就挡住了迎面而来的短刀。“铛”的一声脆响，火花四溅。黑衣人显然是练过的，招式狠辣，招招致命。沈星河以一敌四，却丝毫不落下风，绣春刀在他手中仿佛有了生命，每一刀都精准地避开对方的攻击，同时朝着对方的破绽砍去。
萧琰躲在绸缎庄门口，看着眼前激烈的打斗，心里既紧张又着急。他看到其中一个黑衣人悄悄绕到沈星河身后，举起短刀就要刺过去，连忙大喊：“沈公子，小心身后！”
沈星河听到提醒，立刻侧身躲开，同时反手一刀，划破了那个黑衣人的手臂。黑衣人吃痛，惨叫一声，手中的短刀掉落在地。其他几个黑衣人见势不妙，对视一眼，虚晃一招，转身就跑。沈星河想去追，却被萧琰拉住：“沈公子，别追了，他们肯定是故意引你离开，我们还是先去墨宝斋吧。”
沈星河想想也是，便收起绣春刀，和萧琰快步走向城西的墨宝斋。墨宝斋是洛阳城里有名的字画店，掌柜的姓王，是个五十多岁的老者，为人和善。见到沈星河，王掌柜连忙迎了上来：“沈公子，今日怎么有空来小店？”
沈星河拿出那张御马画像，递给王掌柜：“王掌柜，你看看这画像上的记号，是不是你们墨宝斋的？”
王掌柜接过画像，仔细看了看那处墨痕，点了点头：“没错，这确实是我们墨宝斋的印章样式，不过这印章是去年就不用了的，因为刻章的匠人病逝了，后来就换了新的印章。”他顿了顿，又道，“对了，上个月有个穿着青色长衫的人来买过类似的画像，还特意让我们按照旧印章的样式盖了这个记号。”
“那人长什么样？”沈星河连忙问道。
“中等身材，脸上留着山羊胡，说话带着点北方口音。”王掌柜回忆道，“他当时说要给远方的朋友寄去，还特意叮嘱我们不要把这件事告诉别人。”
沈星河和萧琰对视一眼，心里都有了底。这个山羊胡很可能就是和突厥细作勾结的人。“王掌柜，谢谢你提供的线索。”沈星河掏出一些碎银子递给王掌柜，“如果再见到那个人，一定要第一时间通知我。”
离开墨宝斋，萧琰问道：“沈公子，接下来我们该怎么办？”
“我们去城郊的乱葬岗看看，或许能找到更多线索。”沈星河说道。
两人雇了一辆马车，朝着城郊的乱葬岗赶去。乱葬岗位于洛阳城西边的山坡上，这里荒草丛生，到处都是无主的坟墓，阴风阵阵，让人不寒而栗。沈星河拿出提前准备好的火把，点燃后递给萧琰一支：“小心点，这里可能有陷阱。”
萧琰接过火把，跟着沈星河小心翼翼地往前走。他们按照沈星河之前所说的位置，找到了那摊干涸的血迹和几根马鬃。萧琰蹲下身，仔细查看地面，忽然发现泥土里有一个细微的脚印，脚印边缘还沾着一点绿色的粉末。
“沈公子，你看这个。”萧琰指着脚印说道。

沈星河蹲下身，用手指沾了一点绿色粉末，放在鼻尖闻了闻：“这是‘断魂草’的粉末，有毒，通常用来制作迷药。看来那些人用迷药迷晕了御马，才把它带走的。”他顺着脚印的方向看去，只见脚印一直延伸到山坡下的一条小路，“这条路通往城外的黑松林，我们去看看。”
两人沿着小路往前走，刚走到黑松林门口，就听到里面传来马蹄声。沈星河示意萧琰躲在树后，自己则悄悄探出头去。只见林子里有几个穿着突厥服饰的人，正牵着一匹白色的骏马，显然就是那匹失窃的御马。
“就是他们！”沈星河低声道，拔出绣春刀就要冲进去，却被萧琰拉住：“沈公子，他们人多，我们硬拼肯定不行，不如先回去叫人。”
沈星河想想也是，便和萧琰悄悄退了回去，快马加鞭赶回锦衣卫北镇抚司。北镇抚司的指挥使姓周，是个四十多岁的中年人，面容严肃。听完沈星河的汇报，周指挥使立刻下令：“传我命令，调五百锦衣卫，随我去黑松林捉拿突厥细作，夺回御马！”
很快，五百名锦衣卫集结完毕，个个身着飞鱼服，腰佩绣春刀，骑着高头大马，浩浩荡荡地朝着黑松林赶去。萧琰也跟着他们一起去了，他虽然不能参与打斗，但可以帮忙留意周围的动静。
到达黑松林后，周指挥使下令将黑松林团团围住，然后派沈星河带着十几名锦衣卫悄悄摸进去。林子里的突厥细作很快就发现了他们，双方立刻展开了激烈的打斗。突厥细作虽然勇猛，但锦衣卫训练有素，装备精良，很快就占据了上风。
萧琰躲在林子外，心里十分紧张。他看到沈星河手持绣春刀，在突厥细作中穿梭，每一刀都能击倒一个敌人。就在这时，一个突厥细作趁着混乱，骑着御马朝着林子外冲来。萧琰见状，立刻捡起地上的一根树枝，挡在路中间。
突厥细作没想到会有人挡路，一时没反应过来，被树枝绊倒，从马背上摔了下来。萧琰趁机冲上去，想要拉住马缰绳，却被突厥细作抓住了手臂。就在这危急时刻，沈星河及时赶到，一刀砍倒了突厥细作，救下了萧琰。
“你没事吧？”沈星河关切地问道。
萧琰摇了摇头：“我没事，多亏了你。”
此时，战斗已经结束，大部分突厥细作都被抓获，只有少数几人逃脱。周指挥使让人检查御马，果然在马鞍里找到了那份边境布防图纸。“太好了，图纸找回来了！”周指挥使高兴地说道，“沈星河，这次你立了大功，还有这位萧公子，也多亏了你帮忙。”
萧琰连忙说道：“大人过奖了，我只是做了我该做的。”
回到北镇抚司后，周指挥使设宴招待沈星河和萧琰。席间，周指挥使对萧琰赞不绝口：“萧公子不仅才华出众，还如此勇敢机智，真是难得。我看你很有当锦衣卫的潜质，要不要考虑加入我们？”
萧琰愣了一下，他从来没想过要当锦衣卫。他看着沈星河，沈星河也看着他，眼中带着鼓励。萧琰想了想，说道：“大人，多谢您的厚爱。但我此次来洛阳，是为了参加科举考试，希望能金榜题名，为国效力。不过，如果以后朝廷有需要，我一定会尽我所能。”
周指挥使笑了笑：“好，有志气！不管你以后做什么，只要是为了朝廷，为了百姓，都是好样的。”
宴会结束后，沈星河送萧琰回悦来客栈。路上，沈星河说道：“萧公子，今天谢谢你。如果不是你，我们可能就抓不到那个突厥细作，也找不到图纸了。”
萧琰笑着说道：“我们是朋友，互相帮忙是应该的。对了，沈公子，那些逃脱的突厥细作会不会再来找麻烦？”
“放心吧，我们已经加强了洛阳城的巡逻，而且已经派人去追查那些逃脱的细作了，相信很快就能抓到他们。”沈星河说道，“你安心准备科举考试，有什么事随时找我。”
回到客栈后，萧琰躺在床上，心里久久不能平静。今天的经历让他对锦衣卫有了全新的认识，他们不再是传说中冷酷无情的人，而是为了朝廷和百姓，不惜牺牲自己的英雄。同时，他也意识到，自己身上肩负着更大的责任。他暗下决心，一定要好好准备科举考试，将来金榜题名，和沈星河他们一起，为守护朝廷和百姓贡献自己的力量。
content_en:
Shen Xinghe's fingertips gently rubbed the edge of the tea cup, and his eyes fell on the bustling street outside the window. His tone was a bit solemn: "We found out that on the night the royal horse was stolen, someone had seen a similar white figure in a mass grave on the outskirts of the city. But when we rushed over, we only found a few horse hairs and a pool of dried blood. What's even more strange is that a Turkic wolf tooth charm was also found nearby - this thing is usually a token of news between craftsmen."
Xiao Yan paused slightly while holding the tea cup, and frowned: "So, the royal horse was probably kidnapped by the Turks? But why would they risk stealing a horse? Wouldn't it be more convenient to just send someone to steal the blueprint?"
"This is what we are confused about." Shen Xinghe took out a neatly folded piece of paper from his arms and spread it on the table. "This is the portrait of the royal horse before it was stolen. Look at its hoofs -" Xiao Yan took a closer look and saw a crescent-shaped scar on the right hind hoof of the white horse in the portrait. "This horse is three years old. He had been injured while hunting, and a small piece of iron filings was embedded in the horse's hoof bone, which made a special "clack" sound when it ran. We speculate that the Turks may have wanted to take advantage of the horse's recognition to take the drawing out of the city. After all, the city gates are strict about pedestrians, but the inspection of horses is looser. "
Xiao Yan's fingertips lightly traced the edge of the drawing, and suddenly noticed a subtle ink mark in the corner of the painting, like some kind of mark. "Mr. Shen, look here -" he pointed to the ink mark, "it doesn't look like the artist left it accidentally, but rather it looks like it was painted on purpose."
Shen Xinghe took a closer look, and a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes: "If you don't tell me, I really didn't notice it. This mark... looks like the seal of 'Mo Baozhai' in the west of the city." He stood up immediately, "Let's go to Mo Baozhai and ask."
The two of them quickly went downstairs. As soon as they walked out of Luoyang Building, they saw a few people in black shorts staring at them furtively at the corner of the street. Shen Xinghe's eyes turned cold and he calmly put his hand on the embroidered spring knife at his waist: "It seems that someone doesn't want us to investigate further." He whispered to Xiao Yan, "If there is any movement later, you can hide in the silk and satin shop next to it and don't come out."
As soon as Xiao Yan nodded, the men in black rushed over, holding short knives in their hands, and rushed towards Shen Xinghe. Shen Xinghe reacted very quickly and pulled out the Xiuchun Dao. The sword flashed and blocked the oncoming dagger. There was a crisp sound of "clang" and sparks flew everywhere. The man in black has obviously practiced, his moves are ruthless and deadly. Shen Xinghe was one against four, but he did not lose in the slightest. The Xiuchun Knife seemed to have come to life in his hands. Each knife accurately avoided the opponent's attacks and at the same time slashed towards the opponent's weak points.
Xiao Yan hid at the entrance of the silk shop, watching the fierce fighting in front of him, feeling nervous and anxious. He saw one of the men in black sneaking up behind Shen Xinghe, raising his short knife to stab him, and quickly shouted: "Master Shen, watch your back!"
When Shen Xinghe heard the reminder, he immediately ducked sideways, and at the same time slashed the arm of the man in black with his backhand. The man in black screamed in pain and dropped the short knife in his hand to the ground. Several other men in black saw that the situation was not good, looked at each other, made a feint, turned around and ran away. Shen Xinghe wanted to chase, but Xiao Yan held him back: "Master Shen, stop chasing. They must have deliberately lured you away. Let's go to Mo Baozhai first."
Shen Xinghe thought about it, put away the embroidered spring knife, and walked quickly to the Mo Baozhai in the west of the city with Xiao Yan. Mo Baozhai is a famous calligraphy and painting shop in Luoyang City. The shopkeeper's surname is Wang. He is an old man in his fifties and a kind-hearted man. Seeing Shen Xinghe, Shopkeeper Wang hurriedly greeted him: "Master Shen, why are you free to come to the shop today?"
Shen Xinghe took out the portrait of the royal horse and handed it to Shopkeeper Wang: "Shopkeeper Wang, look at the marks on this portrait. Is it from your Mo Baozhai?"
Shopkeeper Wang took the portrait, looked at the ink marks carefully, and nodded: "Yes, this is indeed our ink mark."The seal style of Baozhai, but this seal was no longer used last year because the craftsman who carved the seal died of illness, and a new seal was later replaced. He paused and then said, "By the way, last month a man wearing a green gown came to buy a similar portrait, and he specifically asked us to stamp it with this mark in the style of the old seal." "
“What does that person look like? Shen Xinghe asked quickly.
"Medium build, with a goatee on his face and a slight northern accent. "Shopkeeper Wang recalled, "He said at that time that he would send it to friends far away, and he also specifically told us not to tell others about it. "
Shen Xinghe and Xiao Yan looked at each other and felt confident. This goatee is probably the person who colluded with the Turks. "Shopkeeper Wang, thank you for the clues you provided. Shen Xinghe took out some broken silver and handed it to Shopkeeper Wang, "If you see that person again, you must notify me as soon as possible." "
After leaving Mo Baozhai, Xiao Yan asked: "Master Shen, what should we do next? "
“Let’s go check out the mass graves on the outskirts of the city, maybe we can find more clues. "Shen Xinghe said.
The two hired a carriage and headed towards the mass graves on the outskirts of the city. The mass grave is located on the hillside to the west of Luoyang City. It is overgrown with grass and ownerless graves everywhere. The cold wind makes people shudder. Shen Xinghe took out the torch he had prepared in advance, lit it and handed one to Xiao Yan: "Be careful, there may be a trap here. "
Xiao Yan took the torch and followed Shen Xinghe forward cautiously. They found the pool of dried blood and a few horse hairs according to the location mentioned by Shen Xinghe. Xiao Yan squatted down and looked at the ground carefully, and suddenly found a tiny footprint in the soil, with a little green powder on the edge of the footprint.
"Master Shen, look at this. "Xiao Yan said, pointing to the footprints.
Shen Xinghe knelt down, dipped a little green powder on his finger, put it to the tip of his nose and smelled it: "This is the powder of 'Soul-Destroying Grass', it is poisonous and is usually used to make intoxicants. It seems that those people used drugs to stun the royal horse and then took it away. He looked in the direction of the footprints and saw that the footprints extended to a path at the foot of the hillside. "This road leads to the black pine forest outside the city. Let's go take a look." "
The two of them walked forward along the path. As soon as they reached the entrance of the black pine forest, they heard the sound of horse hooves coming from inside. Shen Xinghe signaled Xiao Yan to hide behind the tree, while he quietly poked his head out. I saw a few people in Turkic costumes in the forest, leading a white horse, which was obviously the stolen royal horse.
"It's them! Shen Xinghe whispered. He pulled out the Xiuchun Knife and was about to rush in, but was held back by Xiao Yan: "Mr. Shen, there are so many of them. We definitely can't fight head-on. It's better to go back and call for help first." "
Shen Xinghe thought about it, so he and Xiao Yan retreated quietly and hurried back to Fusi, Jinyiwei North Town. The commander of Fusi in Beizhen is named Zhou. He is a middle-aged man in his forties with a serious face. After listening to Shen Xinghe's report, Commander Zhou immediately issued an order: "Pass my order and dispatch five hundred guards in brocade uniforms to follow me to the black pine forest to capture the Turks and seize the royal horse! "
Soon, the five hundred Jin Yiwei gathered, all wearing flying fish uniforms, with embroidered spring knives on their waists, riding tall horses, and rushed towards the black pine forest. Xiao Yan also went with them. Although he could not participate in the fight, he could help pay attention to the surrounding movements.
After arriving at the black pine forest, Commander Zhou ordered the black pine forest to be surrounded, and then sent Shen Xinghe and more than a dozen Jinyi guards to sneak in quietly. The Turks in the forest soon discovered them, and the two sides immediately started a fierce fight. Although the Turks were brave, the Jinyiwei were well-trained and well-equipped, and they quickly gained the upper hand.
Xiao Yan hid outside the forest, feeling very nervous. He saw Shen Xinghe holding a Xiuchun knife, weaving through the Turks' crafts, and each knife could knock down an enemy. At this moment, a Turkic spy took advantage of the chaos and rode onHe rushed towards the forest with his royal horse. When Xiao Yan saw this, he immediately picked up a branch from the ground and blocked it in the middle of the road.
Tujue Xizuo didn't expect that someone would block his way. He couldn't react for a moment, tripped over a branch and fell off his horse. Xiao Yan took the opportunity to rush forward and wanted to hold the horse's reins, but Tujue Xizuo grabbed his arm. At this critical moment, Shen Xinghe arrived in time, chopped down Tujue Xizuo with one knife, and saved Xiao Yan.
"Are you okay?" Shen Xinghe asked with concern.
Xiao Yan shook his head: "I'm fine, thanks to you."
By this time, the fighting was over, and most of the Turks had been captured, with only a few escaping. Commander Zhou asked people to check the royal horse, and sure enough they found the border defense blueprint in the saddle. "Great, the blueprints are back!" Commander Zhou said happily, "Shen Xinghe, you have made a great contribution this time, and Mr. Xiao is also thanks to your help."
Xiao Yan said quickly: "Your Excellency, I'm sorry, I just did what I should do."
After returning to Fusi, Beizhen, Commander Zhou hosted a banquet for Shen Xinghe and Xiao Yan. During the dinner, Commander Zhou was full of praise for Xiao Yan: "Master Xiao is not only talented, but also so brave and resourceful. It is really rare. I think you have the potential to be a royal guard. Do you want to consider joining us?"
Xiao Yan was stunned for a moment. He had never thought of becoming a royal guard. He looked at Shen Xinghe, and Shen Xinghe looked at him with encouragement in his eyes. Xiao Yan thought for a moment and said, "Sir, thank you for your kindness. But I came to Luoyang this time to take part in the imperial examination. I hope to be on the gold medal list and serve the country. However, if the court needs it in the future, I will definitely do my best."
Commander Zhou smiled: "Okay, be ambitious! No matter what you do in the future, as long as it is for the court and the people, it will be good."
After the banquet, Shen Xinghe sent Xiao Yan back to Yuelai Inn. On the way, Shen Xinghe said: "Master Xiao, thank you for today. If it weren't for you, we might not be able to catch that Turkic craftsman, and we wouldn't be able to find the blueprints."
Xiao Yan said with a smile: "We are friends, and we should help each other. By the way, Mr. Shen, will those escaped Turks come back to cause trouble?"
"Don't worry, we have stepped up patrols in Luoyang City and have sent people to track down those who escaped. I believe they will be caught soon." Shen Xinghe said, "You can prepare for the imperial examination with peace of mind. If you need anything, come to me anytime."
After returning to the inn, Xiao Yan lay on the bed, unable to calm down for a long time. Today's experience gave him a new understanding of the Jinyiwei. They were no longer the ruthless people in the legend, but heroes who did not hesitate to sacrifice themselves for the sake of the court and the people. At the same time, he also realized that he had a greater responsibility. He secretly made up his mind to prepare well for the imperial examination, to be named on the gold list in the future, and to work with Shen Xinghe and the others to contribute their own strength to protect the court and the people.
